question: Related Questions Q. Plz tell me do we have to recite quran behind imam.espcially in Zuhr and Asr when Imam Sahib is reciting Quitely. 12881 views Q. The mosques here have seperate section for the women to pray.(men not allowed in those sections, i.e. full seclusion from men's praying area) Given these conditions, what is the command as per the Hanafi maslak for women to pray in mosques? Can you please specify the rules for the conitions when there is any other option avaliable and otherwise. 3737 views Q. How to offer salah 2201 views Q. Qasr Salah 1947 views Q. In lieu of below fatwa we have asked the same two months earlier with Moulana/Mufti Anees Sb of chouhan bangar,Jafrabad & he told that " Ise Momool na banaye lekin jamat e sani agar kabhi kabhi karni ho to kar sakte hai, aur uske liye main mussallah chor kar kahi bhi jamat e sani kar sakte hai aur yeh jamat bina Ehqamat ke karni hogi, Imam bina takbeer ke niyat bandh le. Now please see above lines and clarify the same. Jaza kallah previously Asked: Agar Masjid main Kharji hissa na ho aur kabhi kabhi jamat e sani karni ho to kya kar sakte hai aur uska kya tareeqa hoga? Answer: 9900 04 Jan, 2009 (Fatwa: 22/18=B/1429) According to Hanafi Fiqh, second Jamat is makrooh in the mosque of locality. If the jamat is once performed there is no need to do the second jamat. Remaining people should offer salah individually. If there is any shop, house or open place outside the main mosque where jamat is possible then it can be done there. and Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) Knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband 2286 views Q. This Nafil Sala'h will be the Qaza or Kaffara for atleast Sala'h of 700 years. WallahuAlam, but I did not heared this thing before, please clarify my doubts, Allah will bless you. answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 162469 Country: India Title: Which way is better to pronounce azan, with wudhu or with out wudhu? Please clarify. Question: Which way is better to pronounce azan, with wudhu or with out wudhu? Please clarify. Answer ID: 162469 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1163/1054/M=9/1439) It is better to pronounce azan in the state of wudhu. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
